shared_bank: 5 fixed appendix roles on canonical 256 rows
specific_bank: Shared plus domain-support resampling, source resampling, continuous-only transport, geographic-feature exclusion; source-pool expansion explicitly recorded
specific_temporal_note: No fake within-year timestamp: use cross-year support alignment, no row-order recency
fusion: paper confidence/agreement weights and Base gate; trained on disjoint SOURCE calibration only
selection: source selection cross-entropy; no test-label tuning; lambda grid [0.0001,0.001,0.01,0.1]
extra_supervision: 4096 disjoint source labels used for fitting/selection of fusion; Specific candidates can access labeled pool beyond canonical 256
paper_table: reference only; not objective of optimizer
shared_policy_scope: one task-specific policy per prediction task, pooled CA2014/CA2018 source calibration; same parameters across geographic and temporal scenarios
